question: Should OpenClaw accept this bounded compatibility window for official plugins published with v2026.7.1-beta.5 after reconciling the branch with current main?
rationale: The implementation deliberately reopens deprecated public SDK and whole-store session mutation surfaces; maintainer intent is required to accept that upgrade contract and its scheduled removal obligation.

options.title: Accept bounded compatibility
options.body: Land the reconciled exact-import bridge, retain the October 12, 2026 removal record, and migrate official plugins before that deadline.

options.title: Withdraw beta compatibility
options.body: Close the repair only if OpenClaw intentionally accepts that official beta.5 plugins will fail against the SQLite-backed release candidate.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded compatibility
recommendation.body: Land the reconciled exact-import bridge, retain the October 12, 2026 removal record, and migrate official plugins before that deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has substantial prior SDK and session-store boundary history and authored the focused compatibility branch.
